proof.note: A logo earns its keep across a whole system. Look at how one comes together, end to end.

faq.q: What does a logo design agency do?
faq.a: A logo design agency creates the mark a company is known by: the idea, the drawing, the construction, the colour, and every file and rule you need to use it. We do it strategy-first, so the logo means something and holds up everywhere it appears.

faq.q: How much does custom logo design cost?
faq.a: Ours start at $280, well under a typical agency logo. There are one-time and monthly options, and a logo built as part of a full identity costs less per piece. The full pricing lays it out.
It is simple, it works in one colour, it holds at any size from a favicon to a billboard, and it means something true about you. A good logo is recognised before it is read.

faq.q: Do I get the source files?
faq.a: Yes. You get vector and raster in every format and size, plus the usage rules. All of it is yours on final payment.

faq.q: What is the difference between logo design and brand identity?
faq.a: A logo is one mark. A brand identity is the whole system it lives inside: type, colour, voice and the rules that hold them together. We design both, and the logo is stronger when it is drawn as part of the identity.

closing.note: Tell us about the company and what it should stand for. We will draw the mark that makes it impossible to miss.
